description: Machine-readable registry of all specialist plugins with activation patterns and capabilities
extension_pattern: Drop new *_specialist.py in brain/specialists/ implementing BaseSpecialist protocol

ocr.description: Extract text from images using Tesseract OCR
ocr.output_format: Formatted text with metadata about image and extracted content
ocr.notes: Results injected early in prompt (HIGH priority) after system notices

media.description: Analyze video files by extracting frames and generating descriptions
media.output_format: Extracted frames with timestamps and frame descriptions
media.notes: Extracts keyframes from videos for visual understanding

web_search.description: Execute web searches for current information, news, and real-time data

activation_trigger.condition: LLM outputs <web_search>query</web_search> XML tag during generation
activation_trigger.example: LLM realizes it needs current weather data or recent news

web_search.output_format: Formatted search results with titles, URLs, and snippets
web_search.notes: Unique bidirectional pattern - LLM can request searches mid-response via XML tags

docs.description: Search and retrieve Ada's own Sphinx documentation for self-reference

activation_trigger.condition: LLM outputs <docs_lookup>topic</docs_lookup> XML tag during generation
activation_trigger.example: Ada needs to reference her own API documentation or feature guides

query.description: Topic or keyword to look up in documentation

docs.output_format: Formatted documentation excerpts with file names and relevance scores
docs.notes: Meta-capability: Ada can read her own documentation to answer questions about herself

context-triggered.description: Activated when specific context keys are present in request

bidirectional.description: LLM can invoke specialist mid-response via XML tags
bidirectional.flow: LLM generation → tag detected → specialist executed → results injected → LLM continues

priority_order.description: Lower numbers inject earlier in prompt context. System notices and OCR are HIGH priority.

protocol_interface.return_type: SpecialistResult dataclass with success, specialist_name, context, data fields

steps: 3. Define SpecialistCapability with name, description, priority, schemas
5. Implement async process() method returning SpecialistResult
activation_options: Context-triggered: Check request_context keys in should_activate()
Bidirectional: Implement XML tag parsing (see web_search_specialist.py)
Always-on: Return True from should_activate() for global context injection

introspection_endpoint: GET /v1/specialists - Returns runtime specialist metadata with schemas
